item.title: The world in numbers, late 2026: five signals from the newest World Bank data
item.description: The World Bank updated its World Development Indicators on 11 November 2026. Working from the same 15 indicators as this site's dashboard, five signals stand out: steady growth, a more connected world, wider financial inclusion, slow poverty progress — and one series that has quietly stopped in 2023.

item.title: One chart, many views: field parameters in Power BI after the October 2026 update
item.description: Field parameters let report viewers choose what a chart shows. The October 2026 Power BI update makes bar, column and line charts expand hierarchy axes automatically when several fields are selected. Here is how to set it up, with copy-ready DAX.

item.title: Financial inclusion is accelerating — and savings are leading the way
item.description: The World Bank's Global Findex 2025 shows the fastest rise in formal saving in over a decade, driven by mobile phones. Here is what changed, and what it means for teams that measure financial health.

item.title: Five SQL window-function patterns every analyst should keep handy
item.description: Deduplicate records, build running totals, compare periods, compute shares and rank within groups — five copy-ready T-SQL patterns that also run in Microsoft Fabric warehouses.
